title: 第19章 无拘无束第20章 讲道
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
第二天，清晨。
朔衡准时起床在院子里打了一套劲风之章的掌法。
比起五年前只能照葫芦画瓢的青涩，如今，其掌风凌厉的程度足以将巨石轻松击碎。
轰！
朔衡一掌挥出，凝聚的风形成旋涡，霎时间激起漫天飞沙走石。
这还是没用灵气就能达到的程度，若是加上灵气，恐怕就不只是碎石那么简单了。
打完最后一掌，收势，朔衡对着空无一人的角落低声道：“出来吧。”
隐约间，竟有一人影从阴影中走出。
繁花心中的震惊无以言表。
她奉命认朔衡为主，本想暗中保护主人，顺便也观察一下朔衡的习性。
却没想到，身为元婴后期的她会如此简单的被朔衡发现踪迹。
那道如影随形的目光，让繁花连安慰自己是误打误撞都做不到。
这样的实力差距都能发现她……朔衡的灵魂强度究竟达到了何种境界？
“繁花见过主人。”少女愈发恭敬，立刻低头行礼，然后取出二十一张契约摆在朔衡面前，“按照朔家主的吩咐，吾等已完成契约。
主人将契约收好，便算是认可吾等的追随。”
这是一种相当严苛的契约手段。
拿到契约印记的人不会受到任何影响，但只要将契约印记撕毁，被契约的人就会瞬间失去生命。
相当于完全把自己这条命交到别人手上。
这样的魄力，可不是谁都能有的。
朔衡没有推辞，把契约印记收进储物戒指里放好。

现如今他修为尚浅，需要这样的手段在这些人心中增加敬畏。
况且，也是他爹的一片心意。
“通知所有人，半个时辰后我要说些安排。
无论他们在做什么，立刻放下手头的事来见我。”
“是，主人。”
繁花不敢耽搁，立刻下去通知。
“呼——”朔衡伸个懒腰，对着一直站在门口的侍从摆摆手，“去传膳吧，顺便跟我爹说一声，就说我上午有事要办，不去他和娘那边用早膳了。”
“是，少爷。”
——
等朔衡吃饱喝足，时间已到。
彼时，二十一个黑衣人正整齐笔直的站在他面前。
“见过主人。”
有繁花打头，后面的人学的有模有样。
content_en:
The next day, early morning.
Shuo Heng got up on time and played a set of strong wind palm techniques in the yard.
Compared with the young man who could only draw pictures from gourds five years ago, now, the wind of his palms is powerful enough to easily break boulders.
boom!
Shuo Heng waved out his palm, and the condensed wind formed a vortex, causing sand and rocks to fly all over the sky in an instant.
This is still a level that can be achieved without using spiritual energy. If spiritual energy is added, it may not be as simple as just gravel.
After giving the last slap and ending his attack, Shuo Heng whispered to the empty corner: "Come out."
Vaguely, a figure walked out of the shadows.
Fanhua's shock was beyond words.
She was ordered to recognize Shuo Heng as her master. She wanted to secretly protect her master and also observe Shuo Heng's habits.
But he didn't expect that as a late-stage Nascent Soul, she would be discovered so easily by Shuo Heng.
That shadow-like gaze made Fanhua unable to even comfort herself that it was an accident.
Such a gap in strength can detect her... What level has Shuo Heng's soul strength reached?
"Fanhua has met the master." The girl became more respectful and immediately bowed her head in salute, then took out twenty-one contracts and placed them in front of Shuo Heng, "According to the instructions of the Shuo family master, we have completed the contract.
When the master keeps the contract, he acknowledges our following. "
This is a rather harsh contractual approach.
The person who gets the contract mark will not be affected in any way, but as long as the contract mark is torn up, the person who is contracted will lose his life instantly.
It is equivalent to completely putting your life in the hands of others.
Not everyone can have such courage.
Shuo Heng did not refuse and put the contract seal into the storage ring and put it away.
Now that his cultivation is still shallow, he needs such means to increase awe in the hearts of these people.
Besides, it was also his father's wish.
"Notify everyone that I will make some arrangements in half an hour.
No matter what they are doing, immediately drop what they are doing and come see me. "
"Yes, Master."
Fanhua didn't dare to delay and immediately went down to inform.
"Huh -" Shuo Heng stretched and waved to the attendant who had been standing at the door, "Go and pass on the food. By the way, tell my father that I have something to do in the morning and I won't go to him and my mother for breakfast."
"Yes, Master."
——
By the time Shuo Heng had eaten and drank enough, the time had come.
At that time, twenty-one men in black were standing neatly in front of him.
"Meet the master."
If there are flowers at the beginning, the people behind will learn in style.
